summary.result: The results of this study may be helpful to predict infiltration into a tilled soil more accurately by considering Temporal variation of physical properties of soil.
summary.background: Field measurements of porosity, average hydraulic conductivity and average capillary pressure head on a tilled soil were conducted by soil sampler and air-entry permeameter respectively at regular intervals after tillage.
summary.method: Field experiment was conducted on a sandy loam soil at Suwon durging April~July in 1989.
